_note: Research projects (/projects). profile_*, state_*, meaning_*, meaning_desc_* and resource_* display the options of config/research_projects/mvp.json by id; an id without a label shows the profile's own text. The profile's defaultLinkRole is stored in links when the role is left empty and is therefore shown as stored. Project names, questions, roles, notes and resource labels are stored data. error_reason_<reason> labels a refusal by its params.reason. Placeholders in {braces}.
